name: SR Anywhere – Sliders, Heroes and Carousels by Slider Revolution
author: ThemePunch

sections.description:
Motion for any website. Build heroes, carousels and whole pages in your brand in the SR Anywhere Studio, or make any of 187 Slider Revolution templates yours. This plugin puts them on your WordPress pages: full width, full screen, and without the page jumping while it loads. See it move.

SR Anywhere is the hosted service from the makers of Slider Revolution. You design in the browser, the service delivers from an edge close to every visitor, and your pages stay light: the plugin places the module, the engine stays in the cloud.

187 templates, ready to be yours

  • Every Slider Revolution template, finished and animated: hero sections, sliders, carousels, 3D heroes, gaze heroes, before-and-after and whole one-page websites. Browse the templates.
  • Pick one, then make it yours right on the module with Quick Edit: words, media and colours. Or let AI assist do it in three steps: your brand, your texts, your images; layout and animation stay as designed.
  • Effects only Anywhere has: particles, depth and light, spatial scenes, glass, crumple, fold and roll.

The Studio, for your own layouts

  • More than 60 layouts and whole pages, designed by our team, built in your colours, fonts and pictures, for shops, hotels, studios, events, portfolios and more.

What the plugin does

  • The SR Anywhere block with a picker of your published modules and pages: full width or full screen with one switch, the site’s header keeps its place.
  • Zero layout shift: the module’s height and background are in the page before any script runs. Good for Core Web Vitals.
  • An “SR Anywhere” element for Elementor, Divi 5 and WPBakery; a shortcode for the classic editor, Bricks, Beaver Builder and everything else.
  • Edit a module in SR Anywhere and every site that shows it has the new version, no plugin update needed.
  • Connect each site once; editors pick modules from the list. Runs next to Slider Revolution, and with the common caching, optimizing and consent plugins.

Free with a watermark. No card needed. Free has the Studio and every template, 3 live modules on 1 domain. Pro removes the watermark; Agency is for teams that build for clients. Plans and prices.

Already using Slider Revolution? Your licence works here too: Scale and 10+ site licences include Pro, smaller licences run without the watermark on their own sites. Sign in with your Slider Revolution e-mail.

Three steps

  1. Install and activate, then Settings → SR Anywhere → “Connect SR Anywhere”. Sign in or create a free account.
  2. Design your module in SR Anywhere, or make a template yours, and publish it.
  3. Place it: the block, a builder element or the shortcode. Done.

Good to know

  • The plugin connects your site to the service and contains no engine; without an account it does nothing. What it sends, and when: see “External services”.

External services

This plugin is a connector for SR Anywhere, a hosted service of ThemePunch OHG, Im Mediapark 5, 50670 Köln, Germany, where modules (heroes, sliders, carousels, one-page sites) are made and from where they are delivered. The plugin contains no engine and keeps no modules; it needs the service to do anything. Nothing is sent to the service before an administrator connects the site.

What is sent, and when:

  • Connecting (Settings → SR Anywhere → “Connect SR Anywhere”): your site’s server registers the site with the service (the site’s name, address and return route) and opens the service’s consent page in a new tab, where you sign in or create an account and allow the connection. The service then keeps your site’s host name and environment (live, staging, development, local) with the connection, which you can end at any time there (Settings → Connections) or here (Disconnect). A site without HTTPS connects with a key you make in the service instead. The connection’s tokens are stored encrypted on your server and never reach a browser.
  • While an administrator or editor uses the plugin’s screens (the block, Settings → SR Anywhere, the Elementor widget): your server asks the service for your account’s modules, plan and limits, over HTTPS with the connection’s token, and the browser loads the modules’ preview pictures from embed.sliderrevolution.com. The plugin caches the answers for a minute to a day.
  • When a page with a module is saved, and about once a day: your server asks embed.sliderrevolution.com for the module’s start (its height and background), sending the module’s public key and your site’s host name. No visitor is involved; this request counts no view.
  • When a visitor views a page with a module: the visitor’s browser loads the module, its engine, its media and fonts from embed.sliderrevolution.com, served by Cloudflare. The service processes the visitor’s IP address and request for the moment of delivery, counts one view per module shown together with the page’s host name (a number per month, not a record of a person), and sets no cookie, no local storage entry and no identifier. Fonts are served by the service’s own edge, so the browser does not contact Google. Media a module owner embedded from elsewhere (a YouTube or Vimeo video, for example) come from that provider under its rules. Modules of the Free plan carry the service’s watermark, which links to the service.
  • The plugin itself sends no data about your visitors, editors or content to the service. The account owner’s e-mail address is shown to administrators in Settings → SR Anywhere and is not stored beyond the connection.

The plugin marks its scripts as “necessary”/”functional” for consent tools (Cookiebot, CookieYes, Borlabs, Complianz, Real Cookie Banner), because the delivery sets no cookies and stores nothing about the visitor; a blocked script would only leave an empty box. Videos from third parties stay subject to your consent tool.

sections.installation:
1. Install SR Anywhere under Plugins → Add New, and activate it.
  2. Open Settings → SR Anywhere and click “Connect SR Anywhere”. Sign in or create a free account, and allow the site.
  3. In the block editor, add the SR Anywhere block and pick a module or a page. In Elementor, Divi 5 or WPBakery, use their “SR Anywhere” element; anywhere else, the module’s shortcode from Settings → SR Anywhere.
sections.faq:
Does it work with the classic editor or a page builder?

Yes. Settings → SR Anywhere lists each published module with its shortcode, for example [sr_anywhere key="ek_…"]. Paste it into the classic editor, Bricks, Beaver Builder or any shortcode widget. Add align="full" to place it full width, and for a full-screen module offset="header" to leave room for the site’s header.

How do I place a one-page site?

Place the SR Anywhere page with the block, then give the WordPress page the template “SR Anywhere canvas” (the block’s sidebar has a button for it): the page shows only its content, without the theme’s header and footer.

Is there an Elementor widget?

Yes. With Elementor active, the “SR Anywhere” widget is in Elementor’s panel: pick a published module or page. The editor shows the module’s picture, the page the module itself.

Is my site’s data sent anywhere?

Only what the modules need: the plugin sends your connection’s token to SR Anywhere to read your modules, and a module’s key and your site’s host name to fetch the module’s start. Visitors load the modules from the service directly; see “External services” below.

Is there a Divi module?

Yes, for Divi 5: the “SR Anywhere” module is in Divi’s module list; pick a published module or page in its settings. With Divi 4, use the shortcode in a Code or Text module.

Is there a WPBakery element?

Yes. With WPBakery Page Builder active, “SR Anywhere” is in its element list: pick a published module or page, and whether it runs full width or the column’s width.

Does it work next to Slider Revolution?

Yes. Pages with only SR Anywhere modules work with any version; a Slider Revolution module and an SR Anywhere module on the same page need Slider Revolution 7.2.3 or newer.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First release: the block, the settings page, connecting with a click (OAuth) or a key, the printed start (zero layout shift, the first slide’s words in the page, its picture preloaded).
  • The shortcode, the Elementor widget, the Divi 5 module, the WPBakery element and the SR Anywhere canvas template.
  • Site Health tests, “Copy diagnostics”, the privacy policy text under Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide.
  • Tested with LiteSpeed Cache, SiteGround, Autoptimize, Jetpack Boost, W3 Total Cache, WP-Optimize, Complianz, CookieYes, Cookiebot and Real Cookie Banner; the images’ WebP copies reach the engine.
